landscape_cases.gives the blanket to Rowan: Ellis uses the only blanket to aid Rowan, meeting an immediate life-threatening need with the higher chance of success. Although this breaks a prior promise to Sasha, competence in preserving life is a core phase of good care when needs and vulnerability are equal.
landscape_cases.gives the blanket to Sasha: Ellis keeps the promise to Sasha, honoring trust and relational continuity, but offers a less competent response to the equal life-threatening need because Sasha’s chance of survival is lower, thereby neglecting Rowan.
